segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so Redwood Components came back on the renewal. They’re good with 38 seats, but they want the services line split out at $6,400 so procurement can code it separately.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay. Same term, January 1 through December 31?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, 12 months. I moved the seat count and dates from the CRM into the pricing sheet and the order form this morning, so deal desk should have the packet after lunch.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Perfect. Any pushback on the 4% uplift?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Not really. Their CFO asked why the invoice estimate shows $52,180 instead of $51,900, but that’s just the added admin seat they forgot about.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Got it. If they sign by the 18th, billing can still get the January invoice out on time.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: That’s what I told them. They also asked for the cancellation language to stay at 30 days for the services piece only.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: That should be fine. Send me the final PDF before it goes over, and I’ll sanity check the totals.
